routes.trustResourceLoading: Starts a fresh Pi process with --no-approve, --no-context-files, --no-extensions plus one explicit --extension, --no-skills plus one explicit --skill, --no-prompt-templates, --no-themes, and explicit system prompt overrides. Only the installed Jig skill and installed pi-subagents extension enter the campaign as resources.
routes.pauseResumeBehavior: Exit at awaiting-commandments when the operator has not supplied a complete response. Resume with jig init. A clean exit at another active boundary also resumes with jig init.
routes.routeMismatchRecovery: Resume with /skill:jig init or /jig init when the manifest records inherited-session.
routes.terminalState: initialized with kept, reverted, or no-eligible-candidate

routes.trustResourceLoading: Uses the current trusted Pi session. Resources already loaded into that session remain loaded. It never starts a nested Pi process.

routes.routeMismatchRecovery: Resume with jig init when the manifest records isolated-shell.
